published_prior_art.cite: FreidlingZhaoGao2026SelectiveRI: selective randomization p-values are conditionally valid under the sharp null.

LiDing2017FinitePopulationCLT and TianTaylor2018RandomizedResponse provide unconditional finite-population CLTs and iid randomized-selection transfer, respectively, not this selected reference-law transfer.
ShenfeldVanHandel2018EhrhardEquality establishes Ehrhard--Borell inequalities and equality cases, not convexity of this conditional-score quantile.
ChenAndrews2026OptimalConditional treats parametric Gaussian conditional inference, not the proposed finite-population discrepancy rule.
RosenblumFangLiu2020OptimalEnrichment optimizes discretized model-based policies, not this conditional-randomization holdout endpoint characterization.
RosenblumFangLiu2020OptimalEnrichment supplies sparse-program optimization, not an analytic argmax correspondence for selected local power.
A proportional-information weighting reduction is a standard benchmark consequence, not an independent published advance.
TianTaylor2018RandomizedResponse gives an iid randomized-selection transfer theorem rather than a without-replacement enrichment margin frontier.

soundness_flags.label: Gaussian primitive layer: A, b1, b2, kappa, R1, R2, and thm:uniform-selected-transfer through thm:tolerance-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The score normalizations and the finite-population formulas defining the limiting primitives are absent, so “jointly realizable,” the claimed exact mixture primitives, and the Gaussian objective are not mathematically determined by the stated arrays.

soundness_flags.label: ass:complete-randomization and def:sequential-design
soundness_flags.one_line: Stage-1 selection makes the recruited stage-2 set a function of stage-1 assignment, so Z cannot remain product-uniform conditional on realized recruited-unit sets; state chronological stage-1 randomization and stage-2 randomization conditional on the realized history instead.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2405.07026v4, 22 May 2026; cited journal DOI was not publicly inspectable
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines selective randomization inference by conditioning alternative assignments on the realized selection and proves selective type-I control; its discussion identifies the number and stage placement of hold-out units and powerful selection-dependent test statistics as practical open directions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract; corroborating author preprint arXiv:1610.04821
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops finite-population CLTs for randomization-based causal analysis with fixed finite populations and assignment randomness.
The paper defines complete randomization as a uniform treatment vector with fixed group sizes and derives Berry--Esseen bounds for linear permutation statistics.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv version corresponding to Annals of Statistics 46, 679--710 (2018)
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 19, Theorem 9; pp. 21--22, affine selection events
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 9 is a selective central limit theorem for linearizable statistics under its randomized-response selection framework and gives a finite-sample pivot-convergence bound.

source_verification_receipts.version: Advances in Mathematics 331 (2018); author manuscript inspected at https://web.math.princeton.edu/~rvan/yaireh170831.pdf
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2 and 6 of author manuscript, Theorems 1.1 and 2.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1.1 states the Ehrhard--Borell Gaussian inequality and Theorem 2.2 classifies its main equality cases.

The paper represents discretized two-stage adaptive-enrichment policies by a binary-program formulation and uses a sparse linear-program relaxation for expected-sample-size optimization subject to power and familywise-error constraints.
The preprint studies design-based rank-estimator asymptotics and robustness under completely randomized experiments; no selected enrichment transfer is stated in the inspected record.
The paper studies conditional inference in batched bandit experiments, shows last-batch optimality absent further structure, and identifies an additional linear statistic under location invariance.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Give exact finite-population formulas for X, R1, R2, their studentizers, and the limits A, b1, b2, and kappa; then define joint realizability solely through those formulas and recompute the mixture certificate from them.

Replace conditional product complete randomization with a chronological assignment law: stage 1 is uniform before selection, selection is then realized, and stage 2 is independently uniform conditional on the selected strata and observed history.

After repairing the primitive layer, add a finite-sample or explicit-rate selected-transfer corollary for the displayed mixture family, rather than leaving the central transfer only as an unspecified eta_n convergence claim.

recommended_next_step: Revise the probability-space and primitive definitions first; then rerun novelty review on the resulting well-defined conditional-transfer and design-frontier kernel.
